extracted.name: Teddy Bear Juice
extracted.description: A sweet, warm, and soothing drink made with apple juice and honey is perfect for anybody who is suffering a cold or who just wants an alternative to a cup of tea. Do not give honey to children under 1 year of age.
instruction_lines: Mix apple juice, hot water, lemon juice, and honey in a mug; stir. Serve warm.
